info.title: Beachrex API
info.description:
This is the API documentation for the Beachrex backend. Some of the endpoints use token-based authentication via Laravel Sanctum.

 **Authentication**

All protected endpoints require an `Authorization` header:

Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN

You can get your token via the `/api/v1/login` endpoint.

post.description: Send a message to the AI agent and get a response with beach recommendations. Authentication is optional - anonymous users can use free tier features, authenticated users can access paid features. Send the returned session_id with every following message to continue the conversation (expires 30 minutes after the last message; an expired or foreign session silently starts a new one). Send Accept-Language = the page language: beach names and URL slugs (continent_slug … slug) are in that language, main_image is the first photo path. Beach fields come from the database only; the model contributes the choice and match_score. Recommended beach names appear verbatim in `message` so the client can link them.

post.summary: Send a password reset link by e-mail
post.description: Always answers 200 with the same message, whether or not an account exists (no account enumeration). The e-mail is sent after the response, in the request's language, with a link to `{FRONTEND_URL}/{locale}/auth/reset-password?token=…&email=…` (valid 60 minutes, at most one e-mail per address per minute). Rate limit: 5 requests per minute per IP.

message.example: If an account exists for this e-mail, we have sent a link to reset the password.

post.summary: Set a new password with the token from the reset e-mail
post.description: On success all API tokens of the user are revoked (other devices are signed out) and the e-mail counts as verified. The user then signs in with POST /api/v1/login. Rate limit: 10 requests per minute per IP.

message.example: Your password has been changed. You can now sign in.

422.description: Validation error, or the link is invalid/expired (error on `token`)
